title: Lists and Tables
description: Learn to organize content using ordered/unordered lists and display tabular data using HTML tables.

lessons.title: Introduction to Lists in HTML
lessons.content: HTML supports three main types of lists: unordered lists (<ul>), ordered lists (<ol>), and description lists (<dl>). Lists help present grouped information clearly and semantically.

lessons.title: Introduction to Tables in HTML
lessons.content: Tables in HTML are used to display data in rows and columns. The basic elements include <table>, <tr> (table row), <th> (table header), and <td> (table data).

lessons.title: Creating a Simple Table

lessons.title: Table Headers, Rows, and Cells
lessons.content: Use `<th>` for header cells (bold and centered by default), `<tr>` for each table row, and `<td>` for regular data cells. Headers help structure data meaningfully.
